gates.description: Generates a bundle composition report at docs/perf/bundle-report.html using vite-bundle-visualizer. Manual channel only — artifact, not gating.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) --tokens: token compliance audit for HDS components (hardcoded hex/rgba/opacity/radius/spacing/transition values); (2) --completeness: asserts every shipped component has a rich manifest entry for LLM use; (3) --docs: documentation coverage gate (every core component and pattern has a live demo on the docs site: a DEMOS entry in docs-site/components/component-demos.tsx listed in PREVIEWED_COMPONENTS; hds#506); (4) --api: public API surface guard comparing every package.json#exports JS entry against docs/api/api-baseline.json. Default: runs all 4. pretest runs --completeness and --api (hds#390); changeset:version runs --api --update-baseline after the bump, so the Version Packages PR records the released surface at the new version. Merged from: audit-components + check-component-completeness + check-component-docs + check-public-api.

Dependency vulnerability audit wrapping pnpm audit --audit-level moderate. Translates each advisory into a registry violation; critical/high are errors, moderate/low are warnings. Manual channel only (network required).
Generates a CycloneDX Software Bill of Materials at docs/security/sbom.json. Manual channel — produces an artifact, not a gate. Useful for the GRC narrative and supply-chain review.
Audits CSS token bridges and visual overrides against the JSON token source of truth.
Keeps the attribution registry machine-checkable. Checks that registry IDs in ATTRIBUTIONS.md are present and unique, and that asset manifest sourceId values resolve to known registry IDs.
Soft gate that catches the failure mode where a component starts referencing a component-tier CSS variable that the masters pipeline doesn't know to bind.
Validates that all living documentation files are in sync with the current brand values in hirobius.tokens.json. Exits non-zero if stale values found.

CI-safe Figma Code Connect gate (no token, no network, any Figma plan). Runs figma connect parse --exit-on-unreadable-files, fails if the committed src/app/components/*.figma.ts templates drift from scripts/generate-code-connect.mjs output, requires every public cva module to have a template or an exemption in figma/code-connect.json, and renders every VARIANT x BOOLEAN combination locally (getEnum maps are exhaustive and land on cva keys, snippets are valid JSX that only pass real props). Templates without a Figma node URL are reported as unmapped (--strict fails on them). Also runs in pnpm test through scripts/__tests__/check-code-connect.test.mjs.

Lists core components (scripts/lib/core-components.mjs: the core rows of hds#254, less the three 0.20.0 removed, plus Menu, Popover, Tooltip and HdsRouterProvider from hds#393) whose manifest spec has no usage.when of 20+ characters, so an agent has no machine-readable answer to which one when. --report (default) always exits 0, --enforce exits 1 on any miss. Runs at pre-commit with --enforce since hds#340 authored the remaining tags (plumbing: hds#339).

WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio checker for HDS semantic color pairs. Reads hirobius.tokens.json, resolves primitive + semantic color aliases, and reports contrast ratios for critical text/bg pairings in both light and dark mode. Also gates a non-text tier (§1.4.11, 3:1) for border tokens that bound an interactive control's only affordance (#230).
Verifies that hand-authored bridge vars in theme.css stay in sync with the token source of truth in hirobius.tokens.json.

Every theme-sensitive `--x: var(--y)` alias must also be declared in the [data-theme="dark"] block. Declared only in :root, such an alias is substituted there and inherits its LIGHT value when a theme is scoped to a subtree rather than to <html>. Reads the EMITTED CSS, because every token gate resolves the graph in JS where the indirection is correct by construction.

Deprecation-lifecycle gate: every @deprecated JSDoc on the public surface (src/app/components, src/app/layouts, src/index.ts, src/patterns.ts and every package.json#exports JS entry with its re-exports) must carry a future @removeIn <semver>; fails when a deprecation goes past-due (removeIn <= current package version). Runs in pretest since hds#389 D6.
Catches raw numeric width/height style values in app component/page files before they reach the broader audit lane. This is the narrow, fast gate for the most common component sizing mistakes.

MDX content-model gate (hds#497): every content/docs/**/*.mdx page must match content-model.md: allowed frontmatter keys, generated token markers instead of hand-written values, no invented props, no pages for removed or deprecated components. Rules live in scripts/docs-rules.json. Runs in the Docs guardrails workflow and in pretest.

Self-test for check-docs (hds#497): plants each rule violation in a temp tree and asserts check-docs fails on it, so a rule cannot silently stop firing. Runs in the Docs guardrails workflow and in pretest.
Keeps escape hatches visible and well-formed. Checks that only known exemption markers are used and every exemption marker includes a non-empty reason after the colon.

Counts coverage from the FIGMA side: every component set published to the library (figma/inventory.json) must be reachable from code through an @figma JSDoc tag. figma:links --check counts the other direction — components in code that carry a tag — so a design published in Figma and never wired up is invisible to it. Refuses to report green from an inventory marked complete:false, because a hand walk cannot prove a page is absent. firingChannel is manual until a full `pnpm figma:inventory --fetch` inventory is committed; it becomes ci-pr then. Exit 0 clean, 1 unmapped assets or an incomplete inventory, 2 no inventory yet.

Compares the Figma model built from hirobius.tokens.json against the committed Figma snapshot (figma/snapshot.json) and reports missing, extra and changed variables, modes, default modes and styles. Exit 0 clean, 1 drift or an edited snapshot, 2 no snapshot yet. In ci.yml with --ci: fails only when Figma was last pushed from exactly the model the tokens build now (snapshot lastPush.modelHash) and still differs; drift that may be an unpushed change warns, no snapshot is a notice.

Fails when the committed Figma snapshot (figma/snapshot.json, bindingFallbacks) records a paint or effect bound to a colour variable whose raw fallback colour differs from the variable's value in its collection's default mode. Figma renders the raw colour where the binding cannot resolve (a consumer file before the library is published), so a binding over the wrong raw colour looks right in the library and wrong elsewhere (the Kbd shadow bound to color/border/strong over pure black, 2026-10-12; a sweep found 21). Each finding names the node and the fix: set the raw colour to the variable's value and keep the binding. The record is taken by figma/push/use-figma/fallbacks.js and ingested with `pnpm figma:snapshot --fallbacks <file>`; a snapshot that predates the key warns once and passes. Exit 0 clean or not recorded, 1 a mismatch is recorded or the snapshot or its record fails its checksum. Runs in pretest, so pre-push and ci.yml reach it through `pnpm test`.

Enforces the component parity contract (docs/architecture/variant-contract.md#figma-mapping): manifest variantAxes, componentProperties and figmaPropertyMapping must bind to props the component really accepts (TypeScript checker), contract axes backed by cva must be declared with matching enum values, inverted booleans must be "Show …" toggles, and Code Connect templates must map the same contract axes. Title Case property names are advisory warnings.

Rejects every link from code to a Figma file that is not the HDS library (ADR-026, amended 2026-10-07): a retired file (figma/links.json retiredFiles: the old library, retired 2026-10-07 when its duplicate became the one HDS library) or HDS Staging (stagingFileKey, the draft workbench of amendment A4: a shipped component links its library node, never its staging draft). Scans src (@figma tags, Code Connect templates), public (the manifest figmaUrl), docs data (sync-map, DESIGN_LINKS.md, the shipped docs/CONSUMING.md), figma data (disposition, inventory, Code Connect registry), mcp/ and content/docs, and the files the package ships from the repo root (README.md, llms.txt, DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, CONSUMING.md). ERROR on any finding, naming file, line and kind (retired or staging) with the fix for each; figma/links.json and prose (ADRs, figma/*.md, where the drawing recipe names the workbench) are not scanned, and a missing scan root, shipped root file or retiredFiles list, or a staging key that is the library's, fails loudly. FIXTURE_DIR runs it on fixtures/check-figma-retired-keys. Also runs in pnpm test through scripts/__tests__/check-figma-retired-keys.test.mjs, whose real-tree case gates the repo.
A11y focus state checker for HDS components and pages. Every interactive element must have a visible focus indicator.
Catches raw pixel comparisons against known breakpoint values in JS/TS. All JS/TS viewport comparisons must use hds.breakpoints.* — no raw px numbers that match a known breakpoint value.
Catches hardcoded color values in non-CSS color contexts that bypass the CSS custom property cascade and are invisible to check-inline-styles / check-tier-bypass.
gates.note: Demoted off pre-commit in #52 (commit-time friction). #181 re-introduces automatic gating via ralph/gate.sh — a different, lower-friction PR-time channel, not a re-reversal of #52. See #188.

gates.description: Scans all TSX/TS component files for raw pixel values in style props that should use hds.semantic.space.scale.*, hds.space.*, or a var(--semantic-space-*) token instead.

Flags raw px/number layout values (margin*, padding*, position, top/right/bottom/left/inset, gap/rowGap/columnGap, flexBasis) inside inline style={{…}} in src/app/components. Points violators at Box sx (the sanctioned escape hatch) or a named layout primitive (Stack/Grid/Container) instead of check-hardcoded-spacing's generic token-var fix. Introduced with #98 (layout-consistency epic #95, workstream 4).
License compliance gate. Runs pnpm licenses list --prod and blocks copyleft/restrictive licenses (GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL/BUSL/EUPL/OSL/CC-BY-NC/CDDL).

Unified link integrity gate: (1) active docs do not point at missing local files, (2) external href URLs return non-4xx, (3) internal route targets are known app routes. Merged from check-doc-references, check-external-links, check-route-links (13z-6).
TODO: add description — check-manifest-drift.mjs has no leading JSDoc block.
Compares the current manifest/schema.json against manifest/schema.lock.json and flags breaking changes (property removals, type tightenings) as semver violations.

Every interactive state change moves, on motion tokens: fails a raw duration or easing in a component or stylesheet transition/animation, a state change in MOTION_CONTRACT (press, open/close, indicator move, content swap, list enter/exit) with no motion, and an hds-motion-* class with no CSS behind it.

Escape-hatch policy: the non-interactive feedback primitives (Badge, Alert, Callout) are className-only and expose no `style` prop (no explicit style member; HTMLAttributes extensions must Omit 'style').

Enforces HDS prop-value vocabulary on component primitives: feedback tone/variant unions use danger (never error); size unions stay on the sm|md|lg ramp (no default/compact); tone is drawn from neutral|danger|success|warning|info; density is drawn from comfortable|compact. --coverage prints the cva-adoption rollout tracker (informational, always exit 0).

Every props type annotating a component the public barrel exports must itself be exported, so a consumer can name it. Reachability, not the `Props` suffix: cva VariantProps aliases, composition bases, union arms, cast targets and private sub-components' props stay internal.

Every top-level component-factory call under src/ (React.forwardRef, forwardRef, cva, React.createContext, createContext, withHdsPortal, and an Object.assign that wraps one or whose first argument is a component) is immediately preceded by /* @__PURE__ */, and no top-level X.Part = … or X.displayName = … write assembles a compound (hds#365). A bare top-level call or property write is a side effect webpack and esbuild keep, so one in a module that reaches the chunk shared with Button re-breaks the Button-only budget (hds#363, the way hds#358 did). Tests, stories and .d.ts are out of scope; --fix inserts the annotation and reports the writes it cannot. Source only: no build, no network.

hds#206 -- flags raw integer literals on sx spacing shorthand props (p/m/gap/px/py/mx/my/pt/pr/pb/pl/mt/mr/mb/ml/rowGap/columnGap), the exact px-ambiguous numeric-scale form Adrian's 2026-09-26 decision bans in favor of semantic.space.scale.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}, which Box sx takes by name. Parses with the TypeScript API, so it also sees responsive maps, &-selector blocks, any spacing of the attribute, both branches of a conditional and the operands of &&, || and ?? (on a spacing value or on the sx object itself), and a same-file object passed by name, member or spread, resolved by lexical scope (the nearest enclosing declaration of the name wins; a parameter of that name shadows an outer object). Known limit: an object imported from another file, returned from a function or built at runtime is not followed, nor a conditional initializer (const s = x ? { p: 15 } : {}; sx={s}: only an object-literal initializer is read), nor an sx array (sx={[...]}), which Box's SxObject type rejects, so typecheck fails first. Error severity, run by .husky/pre-commit, and its vitest suite runs it over src/ in pnpm test: it shipped as warn and was promoted once src/ had zero findings.

hds#404 -- fails a second copy of the layout-gap name map anywhere in src/: one of 'tight', 'normal', 'inset' or 'spacious' paired with a t-shirt scale step, read as a var(--semantic-space-scale-*) string (also inside calc() or a template literal), SPACE_SCALE.<step> or <x>.space.scale.<step>. The one copy is LAYOUT_GAP_NAMES in src/app/components/box-sx.ts; Cluster, Grid, Sidebar, Cover, Switcher, Bleed, Center, Card and Stack each kept their own until hds#404, with nothing keeping the copies in step. Parses with the TypeScript API and finds the pairing as an object property (quoted or not, through as/satisfies/parentheses), a [name, step] entry pair (a Map or Object.fromEntries), a switch case (following fall-through) or a comparison that picks a step. Ignores box-sx.ts, *.test.*/*.spec.* files and __tests__/ (a test pins rendered output; it resolves nothing), the same names on Box sx's fixed --semantic-space-layout-* vars, the words as CSS keywords, and lines marked // layout-gap-ok: <reason>. Known limit: a step reached through another name, a computed key, a var name assembled at runtime and an if chain are not followed. Error severity, run by .husky/pre-commit, and its vitest suite runs it over src/ in pnpm test.

The design system never produces ALL CAPS text (Adrian, 2026-10-12). Fails the Tailwind `uppercase` class (also variant-prefixed and @apply), CSS or arbitrary-property `text-transform: uppercase`, small caps (font-variant), `textTransform: 'uppercase'` in JS or JSON, `textCase: 'UPPER'` (also SMALL_CAPS) in tokens or the Figma model, and `.toUpperCase()` / `.toLocaleUpperCase()` in code except the first-letter idiom (charAt(0) or [0]). Scans src/, docs-site/, preview/, starter-kit/, tools/, templates/, tenants/, docs/*.html, hirobius.tokens.json and figma/model.json + snapshot.json; skips comments, tests and fixtures. A line is exempt with // uppercase-ok: <reason> on the same line or either line above; the reason is required (a bare marker fails). Known limit: a class assembled at runtime is not followed. Error severity, run by .husky/pre-commit, and its vitest suite runs it over the repo in pnpm test.

hds#486 -- keeps src/ on the type ramp of 5 roles plus mono (display, title, body, ui, caption, mono; epic hds#483). Fails a font size, weight or line height outside the roles: any Tailwind text-<size>, font-<weight> or leading-* utility, a text-[12px] arbitrary size, an inline or CSS font-size/font-weight/line-height whose value is a literal, and a raw rung of the primitive scale (--primitive-typography-size-*); and fails a deprecated composite (typeStyles.h1/heading1-3/technical/eyebrow/..., --semantic-typography-h1..h3/eyebrow, semantic.typography.h1..h3/eyebrow, Text variants heading1-3/technical/eyebrow/badge/doc*). A role var, inherit, unset and initial are fine. Also reads hirobius.tokens.json: exactly six live semantic.typography composites, and each deprecated alias (h1, h2, h3 to title; eyebrow to caption) equal to its role. Exempts tokens.ts and text.tsx (they define the deprecated names), generated CSS/TS, fonts.css and tests; a line is exempt with // type-ramp-ok: <reason> on the same line or either line above. Known limit: a value reached through an identifier or a class name assembled at runtime is not followed. Error severity, run by .husky/pre-commit, and its vitest suite runs it over src/ in pnpm test.

Joins the four records that describe a component -- source file, manifest entry, docs-site page, Figma node -- into one table with a per-component verdict, so an editing target can be looked up instead of remembered. Re-derives each docsPage from the docs routing (core set + patterns) rather than trusting the manifest, so a stale manifest fails rather than passing a gate whose job is to prove the records agree. Fails on a drop in docs-page or Figma coverage and on manifest drift. Expectations come from the ratified disposition (hds#235): a layout primitive is never reported as missing a Figma node it is not supposed to have. Also writes docs/sync-map.json (--write) -- committed generated output the agent-facing README describes as 'the same data for agents'. --check (hds#277) recomputes it and diffs byte-for-byte against what's on disk, failing and naming every disagreeing component if the committed file has drifted from its source records (hand-edited or stale). Pre-commit runs the plain gate (coverage checks) and `--check` (docs/sync-map.json drift) back to back.

Keeps the agent-consistency figures in root status.json and the README in step with the latest eval/consistency/ledger.json entry, so a hand-typed number cannot silently go stale (hds#285, hds#343). `--check` fails on drift.

State-surface registry gate (hds#612, spec ops#576): docs/state-surfaces.json lists every file or section that describes project state as generated (a generator builds it; it names a `check` command that proves it fresh, which the gate verifies is a node script that exists and, when passed --check, handles --check, or says `freshness: unchecked`), checked (a named gate compares it with the code) or editorial (owner, reviewedAt, maxAgeDays). The gate fails on a registered path that does not exist (SURFACE_MISSING), a `by` script that does not exist, a generated surface with no verifiable check and no `unchecked` (REGISTRY_INVALID), a reviewedAt in the future, and a repo path named in non-generated markdown (registered files, markdown inside registered directories, README/CLAUDE/CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS; fenced code and HTML comments skipped; links resolve against their own file, root-absolute links against the repo root, `path §n` names the path; gitignored build output counts as present) that does not exist (DEAD_REFERENCE). An editorial surface older than its maxAgeDays is a warning (REVIEW_DUE, exit 0) and an error under --strict-review, for a scheduled run. The opt-in registry key registerAll flags markdown in a listed directory that no entry covers (UNREGISTERED_DOC). --run-checks also runs each declared `check` command. Reads --root/--registry, so it vendors to other repos with scripts/lib/gate-output.mjs. Runs in pretest. Fixtures: fixtures/check-state-surfaces/{passing,violating}.example.d, mini-roots passed through FIXTURE_DIR.

Caps the always-on agent context (ported from ops#292; hds#612): the files in docs/guardrails/steering-budget.json (CLAUDE.md and what it marks read-first) are loaded by every agent every session, so their total size may not pass maxTotalBytes, set to the measured size plus 5% (the list includes the generated repo front door, docs/ai/FRONT-DOOR.md). Fix by moving history to an on-demand file, not by raising the cap. The same list is `alwaysOn` in docs/state-surfaces.json, where check-state-surfaces forbids derived facts. Runs in pretest. Fixtures: fixtures/check-steering-budget/{passing,violating}.example.d, mini-roots passed through FIXTURE_DIR.

ADR-010 retired the auto-generated docs/SYSTEMS-LOG.md ledger and named the replacement: git history + CHANGELOG.md + ADRs, plus status.json for the fleet dashboard. Nothing enforced staying current, so it held only when someone remembered (hds#249). Fails when a pushed commit touches src/, scripts/ or docs/adr/ and status.json updatedAt predates it, unless a pushed commit adds a `.status/<branch>.md` note (conflict-free; `pnpm status:fold` folds notes into status.json on main). Commits already on origin/main are ignored. Names the offending commit and the fix. Separately fails when a pushed commit changes what ships (src/; the files package.json#files ships from codemods/, mcp/ and scripts/eslint-plugin-hds/, so not codemods/lib/, minus tests and fixtures; hirobius.tokens.json; tailwind.config.tokens.cjs; or a package.json field a consumer installs or resolves, such as dependencies, peers, engines, exports, bin or files, read from the field diff so scripts and devDependencies edits ask for nothing, hds#448) with no pending .changeset/*.md and no "skip-changeset" marker in its own message, so a shipped change cannot reach a release with CHANGELOG.md and its upgrade note left behind.

Catches local edits to the vendored hirobius/ralph kit files (ralph/{lib,next,run,loop,status}.sh, prompt.md) at commit time by comparing sha256 against ralph/kit.lock.json (ported from ops#492). Pre-commit runs it with --staged, so it only fires when a kit file is staged. --report lists drift without failing; --update re-pins after a kit release.

TDD gate (ported from ops#502): a branch that changes source (src/ or scripts/ code files, excluding tests and fixtures) must also change a test file, else the push fails. Test globs are read from vitest.config.ts test.include, never duplicated. Diffs HEAD against the merge-base with origin/main; skips with one line when there is none. Escape hatch: a `no-test: <reason>` line in any branch commit message (the reason is echoed). Fixture mode (--fixture-mode + FIXTURE_FILE) replaces git for proof-of-firing.

The v1 layout contract (2026-10-07) as a deterministic Playwright gate. Probes a component in Chromium (--html canary) or evaluates saved measurements (--measurements) inside a 480px probe container taller than the child and measures fill/hug width against docs/guardrails/layout-contract.json, height stretch, outer margins, nested padding, form-control max width and sibling widths, horizontal overflow at 390px, and gaps off the xs..xl scale. WARN mode (exit 0); --strict exits 1. Needs `pnpm build-storybook` first. Baseline: docs/audits/layout-contract-baseline.md.

Flags raw numeric Tailwind spacing utilities (gap-2, p-5, px-3, mb-6, -mt-6, space-y-1.5) in src/app/components/**, which ignore density and sit outside the xs..xl scale and the gates that read only style and sx. WARN mode (exit 0); --strict exits 1. Companion to check-layout-contract.

Scans the live demo (.hds-demo-frame) of every built /docs/components/* and /docs/patterns/* page of the docs site (docs-site/out) in light and dark with axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa), so Fumadocs chrome does not count, and fails on serious or critical violations not in scripts/docs-axe-allowlist.json, on a page whose demo is missing (rule no-demo), and on a stale allowlist entry. Needs `pnpm docs:publish` first. Fixtures: fixtures/check-docs-axe/{passing,violating}.example.d, each a tiny built site passed with --dir; CI runs both to prove the gate fires.

Keeps public/llms.txt (and the package-root llms.txt mirror) a conformant llms.txt index (hds#592): an H1, a one-line '> ' summary, every link absolute and under the one LLMS_BASE_URL in scripts/lib/llms-index.mjs, pointing at a file that exists and ships in package.json#files, and no timestamp. The body (voice, recipes, card anatomy) lives in public/llms-full.txt. Runs in pretest. Fixtures: fixtures/check-llms-txt/{passing,violating}.example.txt, a file passed through FIXTURE_FILE.

Runs npm pack --dry-run and fails when the tarball lacks the agent context (llms.txt, llms-full.txt and slices, DESIGN.md, CONSUMING.md, component-api.json, AGENTS.md), the hds-mcp server and the patterns name list it reads, the ESLint plugin entry, the manifest, tokens or dist entry, or contains .env*, repo src/ (other than component-api.json), repo scripts/ (other than the ESLint plugin). Consumers' agents read node_modules, so a file missing from the pack is a file they never see (#341).

Runs attw over the packed tarball so the PUBLISHED types are proven to resolve for a node16/nodenext ESM consumer. Nothing else sees that surface: tsc and every test read src/, and smoke:consumer proves subpaths import but not that their .d.ts resolve. The gap shipped 150 extensionless specifiers into a "type": "module" package, breaking types across 7 entry points with CI green. Profile esm-only (no CJS build here, node10 cannot read exports); the four CSS subpaths are excluded because stylesheets have no types to resolve.

Verifies that the HDS motion system respects prefers-reduced-motion: Layer 1 is CSS transitions (theme.css @media block); Layer 2 is motion/react components, which must read duration/easing via useHdsMotion() rather than the raw hds.motion.* token object (#190).
Verifies that HDS components rendering native form controls forward their ref to the underlying DOM element.

Reads the built dist/ and checks 'use client' both ways: every chunk that imports React (directly or through an internal chunk) must start with it, and every framework-free chunk (brand, tokens, cn, manifest, mui) must not. Missing directives make a Next.js App Router consumer render hooks in a Server Component and fail on first import; spurious ones turn server-safe exports into opaque client references. Re-derives the rule from the files via scripts/lib/rsc-directive.mjs rather than trusting the build plugin ran.
Pre-commit secrets scanner wrapping the gitleaks binary. Registers gitleaks in the guardrail registry so it shows up in audits and fixture-proof runs.
Local security and dependency hygiene baseline. Checks that no committed runtime env files, npm credentials, obvious secrets, external font/CDN imports, or dangerous HTML injection exist in source.
Source-side companion to validators/swiss-canon.mjs. The JSX validator runs on LLM-generated output; this scanner runs on hand-authored .tsx files.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) catches plain HTML elements with 6+ inline style properties; (2) catches suspicious style prop values (function/string references); (3) catches raw color literals in hand-authored CSS files. Sub-mode flags: --inline-only, --style-props-only, --css-values-only. Merged from: check-inline-styles + check-style-prop-values + check-css-values.

Asserts tailwind.config.tokens.cjs exposes spacing/screens/borderWidth/fontSize as theme.extend keys sourced from HDS tokens instead of Tailwind's built-in scale — spacing/borderWidth/fontSize as var(--…) refs, screens as resolved px literals, per ADR-024.
Prevents direct edits to auto-generated output files by checking that if an output file has been modified, the corresponding generator script is also modified.
Validates every tenants/<slug>/tokens.json against HDS structural rules. Runs as a standalone CLI tool and as a pre-commit gate.
Enforces the primitive -> semantic -> component aliasing hierarchy in source files. Direct use of var(--primitive-*) in component and page files bypasses the semantic tier.

Merged gate (13z-6): default mode enforces token description quality in hirobius.tokens.json (missing/blank/verbose descriptions). With --quality flag: also scans generated-token-descriptions.ts for empty, generic-fallback, or one-sided-theme-language descriptions. Merged from: check-token-descriptions + check-token-description-quality.

Merged gate (13z-6): default mode scans src/** for unresolved design-token path references ({primitive,semantic,component,role}.x.y.z) against hirobius.tokens.json — fires pre-commit. With --ratchet flag: B-class monotonic-decrement ratchet asserting .token-path-baseline.txt entry count never increases — fires ci-pr. Use --update-baseline to record a new baseline. Merged from: check-token-paths (scan) + check-token-paths-ratchet (count ratchet).
Pre-commit guard: ensure generated token outputs are in sync with hirobius.tokens.json. A commit that edits the source but skips the rebake silently ships stale tokens.

Compares the current hirobius.tokens.json leaf paths against the committed baseline in tokens.lock.json. Any path present in the baseline but missing from current is a rename/deletion that needs a migration.
Validates hirobius.tokens.json for structural correctness. Catches cross-tier aliasing, theme coverage gaps, and non-monotonic ordered (t-shirt-size) scales.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) prevents raw font family strings in fontFamily style props; (2) verifies @font-face url() paths in fonts.css resolve to real files; (3) enforces fontWeight/textTransform override discipline (single-weight + casing-via-eyebrow policy). Sub-mode flags: --fonts-only, --font-files-only, --overrides-only. Merged from: check-hardcoded-fonts + check-font-files + audit-typography-overrides.
Catches static multi-column gridTemplateColumns values with no nearby isMobile guard. Every multi-column grid must be responsive.
Meta-validator: every gate registered in docs/guardrails/registry.json has a firingChannel that matches actual invocation. Catches aspirational guardrails — gates registered but never really firing.

Meta-validator: walks registry.json and asserts every registered gate has a fixture pair (violating + passing). Stub fixtures warn; missing fixtures error; real fixtures run the gate and assert correct exit codes. mtime-scoped for fast pre-commit runs.
Builds the tree-shaken Button-only root-import bundle (dist/probe/button-only.js) that .size-limit.cjs budgets at 119 kB gzip; runs inside `pnpm check:size` after build:lib.

Does each component consume the component.* token that describes the same property, and do the two agree? Resolves the cva class strings (Tailwind utilities, token aliases, Light and Dark) and the static.css mirrors against scripts/component-token-bindings.json and classifies every component token leaf BOUND / LITERAL-MATCH / LITERAL-MISMATCH / UNUSED. Report mode in pretest (CI runs it through pnpm test); --enforce fails on drift not in scripts/component-token-binding.baseline.json. Covers the reverse direction of check-binding-drift.

Upgrade-ledger schema drift (hds#447): `node scripts/upgrade/schema.mjs --check` fails when upgrade/schema.json is not byte-equal to the JSON Schema generated from the zod source in scripts/upgrade/schema.mjs, the shape the ledger, its compiler and the upgrade command share. Runs in pretest; scripts/__tests__/upgrade-schema.test.mjs proves it fails on a hand edit, and scripts/__tests__/upgrade-compile.test.mjs that this entry exists (validate-guardrail-registry does not scan scripts/upgrade/).

Release-compiler drift (hds#451): `node scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs --check` fails when UPGRADING.md or upgrade/index.json is not byte-equal to what scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs compiles from the committed ledgers (upgrade/releases/<v>.json), naming the file and the fix (`node scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs`). Reads committed files only: no network, no build, never writes. Runs in pretest; scripts/__tests__/upgrade-compile.test.mjs proves it fails on a one-value hand edit to each of the two files, and that this entry exists (validate-guardrail-registry does not scan scripts/upgrade/). The same script records each release at `pnpm changeset:version` (--release).

Upgrade-ledger gate (hds#448): compares the working tree, read from source with no build (scripts/upgrade/snapshot.mjs snapshotFromSource), with the newest docs/api/releases/<v>.json at or below package.json's version, and fails when a fact that takes something away (an export removed or moved, an exports key, dependency or bin gone, a narrowed peer, raised engines) has no step in upgrade/pending/*.json; when a .changeset/*.md has no upgrade/pending/<same name>.json stating its impact (and, unless none, a plain line with no TODO left); when a breaking change (a breaking fact, a note that says breaking, or a step that removes, moves, renames or folds something public, such as a CSS variable the diff cannot see yet) rides a changeset smaller than minor below 1.0 (major from 1.0), or, on the Version PR, a real bump that small; and when a major changeset or version would cut 1.0 without upgrade/ALLOW_1_0. Every message names pnpm upgrade:note. Runs in pretest, so pre-push, CI and the Ralph gate run it; adds about 0.9s (0.86-0.97s over five runs on the 0.21.0 tree, no network, no build).

CSS upgrade gate (hds#449): reads the built stylesheets' contract (dist/css-contract.json, written last by build:lib from scripts/build-css-contract.mjs, with postcss) against the css section of the newest docs/api/releases/<v>.json at or below package.json's version, and fails when a custom property, an hds-* or manifest publicClasses class, or an @font-face left a stylesheet, or a variable's value changed in a context (:root, dark, compact, a [data-brand], an @media), with no step in upgrade/pending/*.json listing the fact; when a removal is covered only by a non-breaking step or rides a changeset smaller than minor below 1.0; when a note step lists a CSS fact the build no longer has; when a variable removed in an earlier release comes back with another value; and when the contract is missing or stale, or the release snapshot has no css section. A Tailwind utility that left is reported for information. Every message names pnpm upgrade:note, which pre-fills a removed or value-changed step. Runs last in smoke:consumer, after its build (CI, the Version PR, pnpm release with --skip-build); never builds.

Verifies the shared guardrail harness and skills tooling scripts this repo vendors from hirobius/ops match the sha256 pins in docs/guardrails/shared-manifest.json (a consumer subset of ops's canonical manifest, role "consumer": --write refuses here). Fails on drift or a missing file so a fix to a shared script cannot silently fail to reach this repo. Runs in pretest, so pre-push and CI (pnpm test) both fire it. Fixtures: fixtures/check-guardrail-drift/{passing,violating}.example.json (FIXTURE_FILE substitutes the manifest).

Verifies every skill pinned in skills-lock.json is installed under .claude/skills/<id>/ and hash-matches the lock (ported from hirobius/ops, pinned in shared-manifest.json). Read-only, no network; run scripts/install-skills.mjs (pnpm skills:install) to fetch a missing or stale skill. Runs in pretest, so pre-push and CI (pnpm test) both fire it. Fixtures: fixtures/check-skills-lock/{passing,violating}.example.json (FIXTURE_FILE substitutes the lock; skills are read from beside it).

Scans every installed skill under .claude/skills for prompt injection, pipe-to-shell installs, secret exfiltration and hidden unicode (byte-identical copy of hirobius/ops scripts/check-skill-content.mjs). skills-lock.json proves the text is unchanged; this proves it is not hostile. Reviewed false positives live in docs/guardrails/skill-content-allowlist.json keyed on the exact text, so an edit re-fails. Runs in pretest. Fixtures: fixtures/check-skill-content/{passing,violating}.example.d/ (FIXTURE_DIR mini-root).

Every interactive component (scripts/lib/a11y-interactive.mjs) states an accessibility contract as @a11y JSDoc tags that reach a11yRules in the manifest, component-api.json and the MCP get_component answer (hds#520). Lists every gap: E1 an interactive root with no rules, E2 a rule with no owner (component|consumer), E3 an owner:component rule whose a11y:<id> is not a literal in an active test (or whose gate:<id> is not in this registry), E4 a component in Overlays/Inputs/Navigation/Actions that nobody classified. Severity error since the family backfills landed with zero gaps: pre-commit runs it with --enforce, so any E1-E4 gap fails the commit (W1 orphan and W2 duplicate test ids only warn).

Stats drift (ops#681): `node scripts/build-stats-json.mjs --check` fails when public/hds-stats.json differs from what the script computes from the code today (public component modules, core and pattern counts, token total, contrast pairs, typography styleCount, the consumer split from docs/data/consumer-usage.json), naming the file and the fix (`pnpm stats:build`, also part of `pnpm tokens`). Reads committed files only: no network, and --check never writes. Runs in pretest, so pre-push and CI (pnpm test) both fire it; scripts/__tests__/build-stats-json.test.mjs proves it fails on a stale number and on a moved source, and that this entry exists (validate-guardrail-registry scans only top-level check-*.mjs and audit-*.mjs). The file ships in the package and as the `@hirobius/design-system/stats.json` export.
